hints.title: Subarray Frequency Counting
hints.text: For each contiguous window of length k, count the frequency of each unique integer.

hints.title: Frequency-Value Tie Breaking
hints.text: Sort distinct numbers in descending order by frequency, breaking ties by larger number value.

hints.title: Top X Summation
hints.text: Sum value * frequency for the first x distinct elements (or all if fewer than x) and record the answer.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findXSum(self, nums: list[int], k: int, x: int) -> list[int]:
        from collections import Counter
        n = len(nums)
        ans = []
        for i in range(n - k + 1):
            sub = nums[i:i + k]
            counts = Counter(sub)
            sorted_items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (item[1], item[0]), reverse=True)
            top_x = sorted_items[:x]
            ans.append(sum(val * cnt for val, cnt in top_x))
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Sorting distinct elements in each of the n - k + 1 windows takes O(n * k log k).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct window frequency extraction is simple and fits Part I constraints (n, k <= 50).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(k) memory for map and sorted list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct multi-key comparator sorting on frequencies and values.
